images.alt: A heading reads "Overnight wave observations 8am Tuesday 9 June 2026". A text box overlaid on a background of waves crashing reads "Baring Head, Wellington, Significant height 4.8 metres, Maximum height 8.5 metres, Period 11 seconds. Steep Head, Canterbury, Significant height 5.8 metres, Maximum height 9.9 metres, Period 11 seconds. White Island, Otago, Significant height 4.8 metres, Period 17 seconds."

post.text:
🌊 Waves are rising rapidly along the east coasts of the North and South Islands, and at the Chatham Islands 🌊

⚠️ Steer clear of the beaches today, and keep an eye out for any advice from your local council and emergency management services ⚠️
